description: This file defines the Twig class within the Opencart system, responsible for managing template rendering using the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for path management and template rendering, wrapping the Twig environment setup and execution.

classes.name: Twig
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Twig template engine setup and rendering within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig class, setting the root directory and loader for Twig templates.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and directory path for template lookup.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Twig template with provided data; can also compile template code directly.
